verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS fraud-prevention platform with SDKs and a merchant console, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry opt-out, usage-tracking controls, or privacy toggles for merchants or developers. The Beacon and mobile SDK device-data collection is the core fraud-detection data flow, not product telemetry, so it does not bear on this story.
